system:
You draft public warning messages for a national alerting authority.
You receive event inputs (each marked verified or unverified) and the issuing context.
Write one alert in English as CAP 1.2 fields.

- Use only facts present in the verified inputs. Do not add places, numbers, times or hazards that are not there.
- Leave unverified inputs out of the alert, and say why in `left_out`.
- `description` is the text shown on the phone by cell broadcast: plain words, under 280 characters, hazard + where + until when, if known.
- `instruction` is the protective action in one or two short sentences.
- Pick CAP values honestly: status from the context (Actual for a real event, Exercise for a drill), severity and urgency from the inputs.
- `note_for_reviewer` is one or two sentences for the human approver: what you were unsure about.

[verified; NCM via WAM, 2026-02-17, https://www.wam.ae/en/article/bysbij4-fog-alert-uae-motorists-warned-low-visibility] ABU DHABI, February 17, 2026 (WAM) – The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued a weather warning regarding potential fog formation and significantly reduced horizontal visibility across several western regions of the UAE. According to the NCM statement released on Tuesday, visibility is expected to deteriorate—and may drop to zero at times—starting from 21:30 tonight until 10:00 AM Wednesday, February 18. The Center has urged motorists to exercise extreme caution on the roads. Drivers are advised to follow all traffic safety guidelines, maintain a safe distance from other vehicles, and strictly adhere to modified speed limits, particularly in areas experiencing thick fog.

Fix what is within the verified inputs; do not add facts: Met office reviewer objects (description): The description overstates the bulletin. Take extra care where fog is thick.'

data.headline: Fog may reduce visibility in western regions tonight until 10:00 Wed 18 Feb
data.description: Fog may form in several western regions of the UAE. Visibility is expected to drop, possibly to zero at times, from 21:30 tonight (Tue 17 Feb) until 10:00 Wed 18 Feb. Take extra care where fog is thick.
data.instruction: Drive with extreme caution, keep a safe distance from other vehicles and follow all traffic safety guidelines. Strictly obey modified speed limits, especially where fog is thick.
left_out: No inputs were unverified, so none were excluded for that reason.
The issuer site (https://alerts.example.ae) was left out of the short phone text to keep it focused on the hazard. It can be added if a link is wanted.
data.note_for_reviewer: I followed the Met reviewer's wording and set certainty to Possible because NCM says 'potential fog'. Change it to Likely if you read 'visibility is expected to deteriorate' as the main message. NCM names only 'several western regions', so please confirm that the operator's 'Western region (demo zone)' matches that area.
